data.one_liner: AES‑256‑GCM encryption/decryption with PBKDF2‑SHA256 key derivation.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple async methods to encrypt and decrypt text using a passphrase. The library builds a binary payload of salt, nonce, ciphertext and tag and works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need client‑side symmetric encryption with a passphrase
Cross‑platform support including web, mobile and desktop
You want a lightweight pure‑Dart solution with strong defaults
avoid_when: You require hardware‑accelerated crypto or custom algorithms
Key management must be done with secure hardware or external KMS
Performance is critical for large data streams
strengths: Strong defaults (100k PBKDF2 iterations, random salt/nonce)
Works everywhere (Flutter, Dart VM, Web) without native code
weaknesses: Relies on a user‑provided passphrase for key material
No support for other ciphers or modes

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level cryptographic primitives including AES and PBKDF2 without the higher‑level payload handling.
